# Extra Scoop Documentation

> Extra Scoop is an institutional media network bridging eyewitnesses on the ground with broadcast newsrooms through hardware-backed capture, automated authenticity verification, and cryptographic licensing.

* Website: https://extrascoop.app
* Documentation: https://docs.extrascoop.app
* Full Unabridged Documentation: https://docs.extrascoop.app/llms-full.txt

---

## Architectural Transparency & Adversarial Integrity Policy

Extra Scoop operates on the principle of **verifiable cryptographic outputs rather than public algorithmic heuristics**.

To safeguard the verification network against automated spoofing, synthetic evasion attacks, and coordinated rating manipulation, Extra Scoop does not publish static mathematical weighting formulas, internal scoring coefficients, or proprietary oracle consensus thresholds. The platform provides verifiable cryptographic assertions, C2PA signed manifests, and public blockchain receipts that can be independently audited by newsrooms and legal compliance teams.

---

## Introduction

* [Platform Overview](https://docs.extrascoop.app/introduction/overview): High-level introduction to the eyewitness mobile app and newsroom terminal workflows, including the platform's core Adversarial Integrity Policy.
* [Platform Glossary](https://docs.extrascoop.app/introduction/glossary): Canonical definitions for core platform terminology, provenance frameworks, and legal deeds.

## Core Concepts

* [Silicon Trust™ Architecture](https://docs.extrascoop.app/concepts/silicon-trust): Multi-stage authenticity and provenance pipeline incorporating decentralised synthetic media and deepfake detection (still image spectral/frequency analysis and video temporal/biological consistency), automated dealroom quarantine, neural watermarking, C2PA manifest injection, and the Provenance Invariance raw file purge guarantee.
* [Digital Deeds & Provenance](https://docs.extrascoop.app/concepts/digital-deeds): Standardised ownership instruments anchored to the Base layer-2 blockchain and decentralised IPFS storage, providing legal indemnity and transparent commercial terms.
* [Trust Scores & Verification](https://docs.extrascoop.app/concepts/trust-scores): Dynamic credibility ratings computed from hardware attestation, temporal/spatial consistency, synthetic-media analysis, and creator track record.
* [Smart Escrow & Settlement](https://docs.extrascoop.app/concepts/smart-escrow): Automated settlement engine locking newsroom funds (£5.00 min to £1,000,000.00 max) and executing instant payout upon licence acceptance.

## Eyewitness Mobile App

* [Quickstart Guide](https://docs.extrascoop.app/eyewitness/quickstart): Mobile app installation, security PIN setup, biometric authentication, source privacy controls, reporting personas (Witness, Field Reporter, Truth Seeker), and dynamic recommendation adaptation.
* [Capturing Verified Footage](https://docs.extrascoop.app/eyewitness/capturing-footage): In-app camera recording, sensor metadata extraction, geographic tagging, and LocalForage offline queueing.
* [The Dealroom & Bidding](https://docs.extrascoop.app/eyewitness/dealroom-bidding): Receiving incoming newsroom bids, evaluating exclusive versus syndication licences, submitting counter-offers, and accepting terms within live expiration countdown timers (3m, 5m, 10m, 30m, 1h).
* [Payouts & Stripe Connect](https://docs.extrascoop.app/eyewitness/payouts-stripe): Connecting bank accounts, tracking available balances and lifetime earnings, and executing automated transfers via Stripe Connect.
* [Ephemeral E2EE Messenger](https://docs.extrascoop.app/eyewitness/ephemeral-messenger): Source confidentiality channel engineered with ML-KEM 768 (Kyber) post-quantum key encapsulation, RSA-OAEP 2048, AES-GCM 256, Apple Secure Enclave P-256 signatures, a strict 15-minute RAM-only session lifetime (64 KB max envelope), and deterministic memory noise wiping.

## Newsroom Terminal

* [Terminal Overview](https://docs.extrascoop.app/terminal/overview): High-speed desktop command centre featuring Workspace Columns, Grid Feed, and Deed Vault modes.
* [Workspace Columns & AI Search](https://docs.extrascoop.app/terminal/workspace-columns): Multi-stream feed organisation, OmniCommand AI search with multi-tier latency caching (Tier-0 in-memory edge cache, Tier-1 semantic vector cache, AI intent compiler, and briefing synthesis), Boolean query syntax (`AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, `trust:>N`, `#hashtag`), and sonar acoustic radar alerts.
* [Concord Dealroom & Licensing](https://docs.extrascoop.app/terminal/concord-dealroom): Evaluating verification reports, placing commercial bids (£5.00 min to £1M max with 3m/5m/10m/30m/1h expiry presets), negotiating counter-proposals, and executing smart escrow locks.
* [The Deed Vault](https://docs.extrascoop.app/terminal/deed-vault): Permanent legal and compliance archive for inspecting cryptographic anchors, verifying Base layer-2 receipts, and downloading high-resolution master files.
* [Wire Format Exporter](https://docs.extrascoop.app/terminal/wire-exporter): 1-click broadcast package export formatted for IPTC NewsML-G2 XML (compatible with BBC ENPS, AP Newsroom, Reuters Connect) and newsroom CMS JSON webhooks.

## Developer Hub

* [API Authentication](https://docs.extrascoop.app/developer/api-authentication): Authenticating programmatic requests using Bearer JWT tokens with runnable cURL, TypeScript, and Python code examples.
* [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://docs.extrascoop.app/developer/mcp-server): Connecting Claude Desktop, Cursor, and autonomous AI newsroom agents to the live intelligence wire via MCP tools (`search_scoops`, `get_scoop_details`, `synthesize_briefing`, `make_offer`).
* [Webhooks Integration](https://docs.extrascoop.app/developer/webhooks): Real-time event subscriptions (`escrow.locked`, `deed.anchored`, `media.ready`, `scoop.verified`) with timing-safe HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.
* [Errors & Rate Limits](https://docs.extrascoop.app/developer/errors-and-limits): Standard HTTP response status codes, error payloads, and API tier rate limits.

---

## Canonical Platform Glossary

| Term | Definition |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Silicon Trust™** | A layered provenance framework combining synthetic-media screening, hardware attestation, and cryptographically signed manifests to guarantee the integrity of breaking news media. |
| **Digital Deed** | An immutable ownership certificate anchored to the Base layer-2 blockchain and decentralised storage, establishing legal title, chain of custody, and commercial licensing terms. |
| **Trust Score** | A dynamic reputation rating computed from multi-factor verification signals, hardware attestation, and community consensus. |
| **Smart Escrow** | An automated settlement mechanism locking enterprise bids (£5.00 to £1,000,000.00) in secure custody and executing instant payout upon licence acceptance. |
| **Concord Dealroom** | An institutional negotiation interface enabling verified newsrooms to submit commercial bids, propose custom terms, and acquire exclusive media licences directly from eyewitnesses. |
| **Deed Vault** | A cryptographically verifiable repository where creators and newsrooms inspect, track, and manage all active, pending, and settled digital deeds and licences. |
| **Ephemeral Messenger** | An end-to-end encrypted communication channel engineered with post-quantum key encapsulation (ML-KEM 768), a 15-minute RAM-only lifetime, and deterministic memory purging. |
| **Newsroom Terminal** | A real-time desktop intelligence desk featuring configurable multi-stream columns, AI search, acoustic radar alerts, and automated wire export. |
| **Wire Exporter** | A formatting engine converting verified media packages into IPTC NewsML-G2 XML and webhook payloads compatible with major broadcast CMS systems. |
| **Provenance Invariance** | A security guarantee ensuring that unwatermarked raw source assets are permanently purged from public access once protected and sealed by the provenance pipeline. |
| **Blind ID** | A cryptographically masked session identifier that shields contributor identity while maintaining verifiable reputational provenance. |
| **C2PA Manifest** | A standardised digital provenance record injected directly into media containers to prove asset origin, capture parameters, and editorial integrity. |
